arxiv-2204-07696.title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Unsupervised Controlled Text Generation
arxiv-2204-07696.creator: Bhargav Upadhyay, Akhilesh Sudhakar, Arjun Maheswaran
arxiv-2204-07696.description: Abstract Controlled text generation tasks such as unsupervised text style transfer have increasingly adopted the use of Reinforcement Learning (RL). A major challenge in applying RL to such tasks is the sparse reward, which is available only after the full text is generated. Sparse rewards, combined with a large action space make RL training sample-inefficient and difficult to converge.

arxiv-2305-02831.title: Local Computation Algorithms for Hypergraph Coloring – following Beck’s approach
arxiv-2305-02831.creator: Andrzej Dorobisz, Jakub Kozik
arxiv-2305-02831.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andrzej Dorobisz, Jakub Kozik. We investigate local computation algorithms (LCA) for two-coloring of k k -uniform hypergraphs. We focus on hypergraph instances that satisfy strengthened assumption of the Lovász Local Lemma of the form 2 1 − α ​ k ​ ( Δ + 1 ) ​ e < 1 2^{1-\alpha k}(\Delta+1)\mathrm{e}<1 , where Δ \Delta is the bound on the maximum edge degree.

arxiv-2307-03377.title: Mitigating Negative Transfer with Task Awareness for Sexism, Hate Speech, and Toxic Language Detection
arxiv-2307-03377.creator: Angel Felipe Magnossão de Paula 1 , Paolo Rosso 1 and Damiano Spina 2
arxiv-2307-03377.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novelty approach to mitigate the negative transfer problem. In the field of machine learning, the common strategy is to apply the Single-Task Learning approach in order to train a supervised model to solve a specific task.

arxiv-2404-04714.title: Data Poisoning Attacks on Off-Policy Policy Evaluation Methods
arxiv-2404-04714.creator: Elita Lobo, Harvineet Singh, Marek Petrik, Cynthia Rudin, Himabindu Lakkaraju
arxiv-2404-04714.description: Abstract Off-policy Evaluation (OPE) methods are a crucial tool for evaluating policies in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, where exploration is often infeasible, unethical, or expensive. However, the extent to which such methods can be trusted under adversarial threats to data quality is largely unexplored.

europmc-pmc6369217.title: Cell Type-Specific Roles of NF-κB Linking Inflammation and Thrombosis.
europmc-pmc6369217.creator: Mussbacher M, Salzmann M, Brostjan C, Hoesel B, Schoergenhofer C, Datler H, Hohensinner P, Basílio J, Petzelbauer P, Assinger A, Schmid JA.
europmc-pmc6369217.description: The transcription factor NF-κB is a central mediator of inflammation with multiple links to thrombotic processes. In this review, we focus on the role of NF-κB signaling in cell types within the vasculature and the circulation that are involved in thrombo-inflammatory processes.

pmc-10649849.title: Microstructure and Properties of CoCrNi/Nano-TiC/Micro-TiB2 Composite Coatings Prepared via Laser Cladding
pmc-10649849.creator: He Liu, Yuzhen Yu, Xi Wang, Hanpeng Gao, Jinku Zhao, Hao Wang
pmc-10649849.description: Laser cladding was used to prepare CoCrNi-xTiC-xTiB2 (x = 0, 5, 15 wt.%) composite coatings on 316L stainless steel. Then, ceramic mass fraction effects on the microstructure and properties were investigated. Results show viable metallurgical bonding between the coating and the substrate, with no apparent pores or cracks.

pmc-11423305.title: Structure-Based Design of CBP/EP300 Degraders: When Cooperativity Overcomes Affinity
pmc-11423305.creator: Iván Cheng-Sánchez, Katherine Gosselé, Leonardo Palaferri, Eleen Laul, Gionata Riccabella, Rajiv K Bedi, Yaozong Li, Anna Müller, Ivan Corbeski, Amedeo Caflisch, Cristina Nevado
pmc-11423305.description: We present the development of dCE-2, a structurally novel PROTAC targeting the CREB-binding protein (CBP) and E1A-associated protein (EP300)—two homologous multidomain enzymes crucial for enhancer-mediated transcription. The design of dCE-2 was based on the crystal structure of an in-house bromodomain (BRD) inhibitor featuring a 3-methyl-cinnoline acetyl-lysine mimic acetyl-lysine mimic discovered by high-throughput fragment docking.

pmc-12471558.title: Inflammation and Albumin-Based Biomarkers Are Not Independently Associated with Mortality in Critically Ill COPD Patients: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12471558.creator: Josef Yayan, Christian Biancosino, Marcus Krüger, Kurt Rasche
pmc-12471558.description: Background: Inflammation and nutritional status are known to affect outcomes in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, their prognostic relevance in critically ill COPD patients remains unclear. This study investigated whether C-reactive protein (CRP), serum albumin, and the CRP/albumin ratio (CAR) were associated with in-hospital mortality in ICU patients with COPD.

pmc-12594048.title: A Rare Case of Cutaneous Meningioma Arising on the Scalp: Diagnostic Challenges, Immunohistochemical, and Molecular Features
pmc-12594048.creator: Kainat Memon, Richard J Digby, Azzam Ismail
pmc-12594048.description: The differential diagnosis for scalp lesions is broad, ranging from simple cysts to tumors. We present the case of a 49-year-old woman with a scalp lesion initially suspected to be an epidermoid cyst but later diagnosed as cutaneous meningioma on biopsy.

pmc-12786049.title: Integrative Multi-Omics and Machine Learning Reveal Shared Biomarkers in Type 2 Diabetes and Atherosclerosis
pmc-12786049.creator: Qingjie Wu, Zhaochu Wang, Mengzhen Fan, Linglun Hao, Jicheng Chen, Changwen Wu, Bizhen Gao
pmc-12786049.description: Atherosclerosis (AS) is a leading cause of death and disability in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). However, the shared molecular mechanisms linking T2DM and atherosclerosis have not been fully elucidated. We analyzed AS- and T2DM-related gene expression profiles from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database to identify overlapping differentially expressed genes and co-expression signatures.

pmc-13093300.title: Influence of Serum Carbamazepine Concentration on the Anticoagulant Effect of Warfarin in a Pediatric Case: Effects of Carbamazepine Tapering and Discontinuation During Concomitant Sodium Valproate Therapy
pmc-13093300.creator: Yuki Shirayama, Yu Takasao, Toshiyuki Shinozaki, Masayuki Abiko, Kota Suzuki, Kosuke Doki
pmc-13093300.description: This case demonstrates an inverse relationship between serum carbamazepine concentration and the prothrombin time–international normalized ratio (PT‐INR) adjusted for the warfarin dose. The concomitant use of sodium valproate further contributes to an unstable PT‐INR, emphasizing the importance of careful and continuous monitoring of anticoagulant effects.

pmc-13217157.title: Multiple Furuncular Cutaneous Myiasis in a 4‐Month‐Old Infant in an Urban Setting: A Case Report From Cameroon
pmc-13217157.creator: Isabelle Mekone Nkwele, Géraldine Lynn Ewane Ngole, Christelle Nadia Mpah Edimo, David Chelo
pmc-13217157.description: Furuncular cutaneous myiasis is a parasitic infestation of the skin by dipteran larvae, commonly reported in tropical Africa, and underreported in infants. We report the case of a 4‐month‐old male infant from Yaoundé, Cameroon, who presented with incessant crying and a rapidly progressive skin eruption over 4 days.

pmc-13220003.title: A Reliable Prediction Method for the Pedicle Subtraction Osteotomy Angle in Ankylosing Spondylitis-Related Thoracolumbar Kyphosis: A Comparative Analysis with Existing Approaches
pmc-13220003.creator: Mu Qiao, Bang-ping Qian, Kai-yang Wang, Chen-yu Song, Jing-shun Lu, Yong Qiu
pmc-13220003.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCareful preoperative planning regarding the reliable angle of pedicle subtraction osteotomy (PSO) in ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is beneficial for sagittal realignment, preventing undercorrection or overcorrection, and mitigating potential mechanical complications. The purpose of this study was to propose a novel method, using AS-specific realignment criteria and Surgimap software, for calculating a reliable PSO angle in AS patients with thoracolumbar kyphosis, and to compare its predictive accuracy with 3 other methods reported in the previous literature.MethodsSixty-one AS patients who underwent 1-level PSO were

pmc-13549599.title: The role of ferroptosis in juvenile idiopathic arthritis
pmc-13549599.creator: Chun-Wu Yang, Xiu-Hua Pan, Ji-Gan Wang
pmc-13549599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study employed a bidirectional 2-step, two-sample Mendelian randomization approach to investigate the causal relationships between ferroptosis-related genes and juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) and to explore the mediating role of immune cells. Ferroptosis genes were identified from the deCODE database and matched with protein quantitative trait locus data as exposures to evaluate their causal effects on JIA, while immune cell traits were similarly assessed.
